name: Guangdong DP Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong DP Co. Ltd., headquartered in Guangzhou, China, specializes in the comprehensive research, development, design, production, and sale of LED lighting products throughout the Chinese market. Their diverse product portfolio includes a wide array of portable LED illumination devices, such as desk lamps, flashlights, searchlights, headlamps, emergency lights, and camping lanterns. Beyond lighting, the company also manufactures electronic mosquito repellents, power accessories like batteries and chargers, various types of electric fans, and electrical sockets with their associated components. Additionally, they provide a selection of residential lighting products. The company commenced its operations in 2002.
